topic.title: Nuclear Sites / Land-Use Planning / Site Licensing
topic.source_contract: nuclear site and consultation-zone identity, planning route, national policy statement, ONR advice, development consent, nuclear site licence, environmental permits, emergency planning, land rights, construction, commissioning and operational regulatory evidence

scope_guards: A site named in policy is not treated as development consent.
An ONR consultation zone is not treated as a development prohibition.
Planning permission is not treated as a nuclear site licence.
A nuclear site licence is not permission to begin all construction.
An environmental permit is not treated as ONR commissioning consent.
Construction progress is not treated as operational authorisation.
Emergency planning information is not treated as proof of site safety performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact planning, licensing, permitting, construction, commissioning and operation evidence.
